definitions:
A number of places in the United States:
A census-designated place in Portage Township, Porter County, Indiana.
An unincorporated community in Noble Township, Wabash County, Indiana.
A minor city in Sumner County, Kansas, named after South Haven, Michigan.
A city in Van Buren County and Allegan County, Michigan, located on Lake Michigan.
A township in Van Buren County, Michigan.
A minor city in Wright County, Minnesota.
A hamlet in the town of Brookhaven, Suffolk County, New York, possibly shortened from South Brookhaven.
A census-designated place in Portage Township, Porter County, Indiana.

blocks.text: South Haven is a census-designated place in Portage Township, Porter County, in the U.S. state of Indiana. As of the 2020 census, South Haven had a population of 5,084.
South Haven is a city in Sumner County, Kansas, United States. As of the 2020 census, the population of the city was 324.
South is one of the cardinal directions or compass points. The direction is the opposite of north and is perpendicular to both west and east.
